gaiaAdvantages: Same messaging habit plus web and desktop apps
Reads email and calendar before acting on requests
Graph-based memory that compounds across weeks
50+ integrations instead of a narrow channel set
Open source and self-hostable via Docker
gaiaReplaces: Poke routines that need inbox context to work
Manually bridging Poke answers into email and tasks
Repeating context Poke does not retain
Workflows across tools Poke cannot reach
metaDescription: Need a Poke alternative with deeper reach? GAIA messages in WhatsApp and Telegram and adds open-source email and calendar power.
metaTitle: Best Poke Alternative: Open-Source SMS AI
migrationSteps: List the Poke routines you use most each week
Connect Gmail, Calendar, and your task tool to GAIA
Move the most email-dependent routine first
Message GAIA in WhatsApp or Telegram from then on
name: Poke
painPoints: Narrow channel focus with limited tool depth
Basic conversation history instead of real memory
Closed platform after the Cognition acquisition
No self-hosted option for privacy-minded teams
Email and calendar stay outside its reach
whyPeopleLook: Poke got the interface right: talk to an assistant where you already chat. The Interaction Company built something people liked, and the Cognition acquisition in July 2026 raised the obvious question about where it goes next. People searching for a Poke alternative want the messaging habit on open ground: same WhatsApp ease, plus email depth, real memory, and code they can inspect.
